title: First Failure
statement: Implement `solve(lint_ok, types_ok, tests_ok)`. Each flag is 0 or 1. Return `ruff` if lint failed, else `mypy` if types failed, else `pytest` if tests failed, else `pass`. The first failing stage is the one you report.
hints: Then tests. All ones return pass.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: The gate is ordered so the cheapest, most local failure is named first when you stop early.

editorial: The gate is ordered so the cheapest, most local failure is named first when you stop early. A pass is all three green. Reporting pytest when ruff already failed hides the formatting error the author should fix before reading a test log.
